paite: Kumpipa in TOUPA'N vai ahawm a; michih ling uhen! Amah cherubte tung ah atu a; leitung ling hen.
heading: Pathian, Kumpipa Tungnung
english: Yahweh reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.

paite: TOUPA Zion khosung ah thupitak ahi a; michihte tung ah tungnung tham ahi.
english: Yahweh is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.

paite: Amau na min thupi lauhuaitak phat uhen; amah asiangthou hi.
english: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!

paite: Kumpipa hatna in vaihawmna a-it a; nang khentuam neihlouhna na hihkip hi, nang Jakobte lak ah vai na hawm a, diktak in na hih hi.
english: The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.

paite: TOUPA i Pathian uh pahtawi unla, akhe ngakna bul ah bia un; amah asiangthou hi.
english: Exalt Yahweh our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!

paite: Asiampute lak ah Mosi leh Aaron, aminloute lak ah Samuel; amau TOUPA asam ua, ama'n adawngta ahi,
english: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on Yahweh, and he answered them.

paite: meipi dingh ah akiang uah thu agen a, athut athu theihpihte leh thupiakte azui zel uhi.
english: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.

paite: Aw TOUPA ka Pathian uh, nang amaute na dawng a; nang amau ngaidampa Pathian na hi, athilhih tung uahte phu la zel mah lechin.
english: You answered them, Yahweh our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.

paite: TOUPA i Pathian pahtawi unla, amual siangthou ah bia un; TOUPA i Pathian asiangthou hi.
english: Exalt Yahweh, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for Yahweh, our God, is holy!
